channel.title: Session Key
channel.description: Automatic updates for Session Key, the menu-bar key and BPM detector.

item.title: Version 1.0.6 (build 318)
item.description:
• Cubase: Session Key now sends tempo to Cubase.
  • Logic Pro: fixed the key not being set on some Macs, where the tempo went through and the key silently did not.
  • Pro Tools: key and tempo both send reliably.

item.title: Version 1.0.4 (build 309)
item.description:
• Tighter menu bar panel.
  • Nothing is ever written to your clipboard.

item.title: Version 1.0.4 (build 302)
item.description:
• Update to build 302.
  • Send to Pro Tools sets the key more reliably. A key only send used to fail with a Key didn't verify message.
  • When Send to DAW is available, it sends the reading you are looking at, including after you stop listening. It used to refuse a stopped reading and tell you to wait for a lock. If the reading had not locked yet, the confirmation says it went as a strong guess.
  • The send confirmation is smaller and sits tight under the menu bar icon. The old one was wide enough to cover a DAW transport.
  • Ring colors now mean the app is listening or showing a fresh file result. Stop listening and the ring drops its color at once, so you can see the stop registered.
  • The idle ring is a clean ring again instead of a cluster of blobs.
  • A locked key still names its runner up, and names both keys, like "C#m or E".
  • The dropdown shows listening time again, with a new Listening time switch under Readout, and it lost its dead space.
  • The menu bar readout is even on both sides at every key and every tempo.
  • Settings scrolls all the way down, so the cents readout and the color blind shape marks are reachable, and every explanation reads whole.
  • A dropped file's tempo can only turn green when the file is long enough to hold four beats of the tempo it detected. This is a change to confidence only; it does not change which tempo the app detects.
  • When no sound is reaching the app while it listens, it now retries once and then says so, and points you at the Listen to setting. It used to sit on "Listening, no audio" for as long as you left it.
  • The analyzing and result bubbles stay under the menu bar icon as the readout grows. They used to drift to the left of it.
  • With "Stop once the key locks in" on, listening ends the moment the reading is final. The panel no longer says a key is locked while it is still listening.
  • The app notices the moment the music stops. It says it is waiting for audio, and the listening time stops counting until the music comes back.
  • New sound wakes it straight away. The idle check setting is gone, because waking is always immediate now.
  • If you are offline for a long stretch, the app now renews itself quietly while you have a connection, and asks you to connect once before it ever becomes a problem.
  • The license agreement is updated and shown once more. You confirm you are at least 16, and that if you are under the age of majority where you live, a parent or legal guardian has agreed on your behalf.

item.title: Version 1.0.4 (build 301)
item.description:
• Update to build 301.
  • New: cents readout. Drop a file and the readout can show how far it sits from your tuning reference, like +14¢ next to the key. Off unless you turn it on in Settings; the menu bar stays exactly as clean as before when it is off.
  • New: settable tuning reference. 432 to 450 Hz presets plus a custom field; offsets are measured against the reference you set. Default stays 440.
  • First launch shows the license agreement once.
  • The color-blind shape marks now ship off; the plain ring is the out-of-box look. Turn shapes on any time in Settings under Readout.
  • New: a My Account button in Settings opens your account page.
  • Settings is reorganized: Listening, a new Readout tab, and License & About.

item.title: Version 1.0.4 (build 298)
item.description:
• Update to build 298.
  • The key and the tempo now sit exactly 4 points apart in the menu bar, for every key and every tempo.
  • The panel stays centered under the icon while you use it.
  • Closes the one case where a song could settle on a wrong key after an unlucky relaunch.
  • Small fixes and polish.

item.title: Version 1.0.4 (build 293)
item.description:
• Update to build 293.
  • Handles m4a files with damaged endings.
  • The ring turns red while listening.
  • The panel opens in the right place.
  • Small fixes and polish.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
• One press sends tempo and key to Ableton Live together.
  • Activate with one click from your email. No key to copy.
  • The key readout holds steadier.
  • Small fixes and polish.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
• Live, on-device key and tempo detection straight from your Mac's audio output.
  • Notarized Developer ID build (Capiscana, Inc.).
  • Maintenance and stability update.

item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
• First Sparkle-enabled release of Session Key.
  • On-device key and BPM detection from any audio file.
  • Notarized Developer ID build (Capiscana, Inc.).
